Order:

entities.text: Moarij Ahmed Khan, vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed questioning the action of respondent No.3 in not conducting investigation and not filing the charge sheet as per Section 173 of Cr.P.C., 1973 in respect of F.I.R.No.267 of 2024,
dated 19.03.2024 on the complaint given by the petitioner against un-official respondent Nos.4 to 11.
A consequential prayer is sought to direct respondent No.3 to conduct thorough and careful investigation in the above crime and to file charge sheet.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home appearing for respondent Nos.1 to 3.
3.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home placed a copy of instructions issued by Inspector of Police, Raidurgam Police Station, Cyberabad Police Station, wherein it is submitted that the respondent No.3 received Court referred complaint filed by the petitioner on 19.03.2025.

entities.text: Raidurgam Police Station, Cyberabad Police Station
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Basing on the said complaint, a case has been registered in Crime No.267 of 2024 dated 19.03.2024 for the offences under Sections 420, 408, 467, 468, 506, 120(B), read with 34 of IPC and Section 156(3) of Cr.P.C.
It is further submitted that investigation has been taken up.
During the course of investigation, the Investigating Officer visited the scene of offence and tried to contact the petitioner - complainant for recording his statement.
But the petitioner did not cooperate.

Thereafter, the Investigating Officer issued notice under Section 91 Cr.P.C. to the petitioner / complainant for his appearance and to furnish relevant documentary evidence on 23.03.2024, 11.04.2024 & 18.04.2024 through post.
But the petitioner / complainant neither appeared before the Investigating Agency nor furnished documentary evidence.

It was further revealed with regard to the subject matter, a civil suit is pending vide O.S.No.193 of 2023 on the file of learned VI Additional District & Sessions Judge, Rangareddy District at Kukatpally.

entities.text: Additional District & Sessions Judge, Rangareddy District at Kukatpally
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is further submitted that as there is no hope that the petitioner / complainant will furnish the evidence or cooperate with the Investigation Agency, the Investigating Officer obtained permission from the Assistant Commissioner of Police, Madhapur Division, Cyberabad vide C.No.13/ACP- Mdpur/Cyb/2025, dated 17.01.2025 and referred the case as "lack of evidence".

It is further submitted that after serving notice to petitioner / complainant on 24.09.2025 through post, the Investigating Officer filed final report before the learned XIII Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Rajendranagar, Rangareddy District vide Inward No.8797, dated 26.09.2025.
4.

entities.text: XIII Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Rajendranagar, Rangareddy District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home submitted that copy of the final report and copies of notices sent to petitioner / complainant under Section 91 Cr.P.C. on 25.03.2024,
11.04.2024 & 18.04.2024 are enclosed along with the copy of instructions and further submitted that though several opportunities were given to the petitioner and as there is no appearance or Sri Moarij Ahmed Khan, vs The State Of Telangana, on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25875588/
1 response from the petitioner, the case has been closed as "lack of evidence" and the final report was filed as "lack of evidence.
5.

entities.text: Sri Moarij Ahmed Khan, vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In that view of the matter, a copy of the final report be served on the learned counsel for the petitioner and the petitioner may pursue appropriate remedies, as available under law for further course of action.
6. With the above observations, this writ petition is disposed of with consent.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous applications if any pending, in this petition, shall stand closed.

JUSTICE N.V.SHRAVAN KUMAR Date:
